completion_contract.scope: Read-only completion prerequisites, not a repeat task-success audit. Existing PID, incomplete records or existing output are refused.

sampling.phase_rule: Unique nonoverlapping attribution: next phase owns a shared boundary using start+1e-8 tolerance; a period endpoint is its last saved sample, not an interpolated phase endpoint.

definitions.native_chart: Literal source Dm2x2: rotate each initial/rest triangle normal toward world+Z, retain rotated XY edges, invert Dm; F=current_edges*inverse(Dm). Native a=(1,0), b=(0,1). Special cos==-1 branch is preserved exactly.
definitions.native_a_b_ratio: Norms of Fa and Fb in a numerically orthonormal rest chart. Value-1 is directional line strain in the native chart, not principal or measured yarn strain.
definitions.angle: acos((Fa dot Fb)/(|Fa||Fb|)) in degrees minus90. Signed angle and its absolute value are separately reported.
definitions.shear_invariant: I6=Fa dot Fb, dimensionless; native energy density is mu*I6^2. I6 also depends on the two column lengths; the normalized angle separates that length factor.
definitions.p95: Per-frame spatial triangle-rest-area weighted quantile; maximum_over_frames_spatial_area_weighted_p95 is the largest such p95 in the period. It is not a time-pooled percentile or a largest-5%-of-nodes metric.
definitions.final: The entire_run last_saved_sample_in_period is the actual completed final saved frame. Phase endpoints are explicitly the last saved samples in each phase.
definitions.principal_construction_distinction: No SVD/principal or construction-direction metrics are recomputed. Native axes vary with initial triangle orientation; neither they nor construction-grid axes identify real warp/weft without fabric measurements.
definitions.rest_area: Constant physical reference triangle area, not current area or vertex count.

source_formula_provenance.location: lines17–28: inverse chart;57–69: fixed a/b and rest area weighting

source_formula_provenance.scope: Prior three-hotspot implementation; full38 numerical values are checked independently above.

limitations: Actual maximum saved interval is 0.05 seconds; native-axis or shear peaks between saved frames may be missed. This is not an integration-step strain log.
The native chart is not a calibrated warp/weft chart. Low native-axis extension does not prove low extension in every material direction or inextensibility.
Angle change can produce appreciable principal stretch even if both native-axis norms remain near1; do not interpret all principal stretch as yarn lengthening.
An individual coarse triangle has no internal wrinkle degrees of freedom; continuum compression and shear are not direct fibre-scale measurements.
No contact-force attribution, effective damping, rebound, hysteresis, textile calibration or future candidate success follows from these statistics.
No native initialization/run, planner search, production/config/assets/default/docs/manifest edit, or observation of an active sibling run was performed.
